title: Dead ternary in method-not-allowed branch
evidence: app.py:118-119 — `allowed` is computed but both arms of the `HTTPStatus.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED if allowed is False else HTTPStatus.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` ternary return the same status, so the variable is inert
suggestion: Drop the `allowed` computation and the ternary; return METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED directly

title: 405 response omits the Allow header
evidence: app.py:119 — METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED is returned with no `Allow` header listing permitted methods
suggestion: Add an `Allow` header enumerating the valid methods for the matched resource

title: parse_qs imported inside request handler
evidence: app.py:94 — `from urllib.parse import parse_qs` sits in the GET-list branch rather than at module top
suggestion: Move the import to the top of the module with the other imports
